meta.theme: walled medieval river town: a stone keep above guild quarters, tanneries downstream, and mud-lane tenements against the wall

types.label: Tavern Keeper
types.boilerplate: You keep the busiest tavern on Guild Row. Every deal, feud and betrothal in town is toasted under your roof, and you pour for all sides equally.
examples: A widowed keeper who waters the ale of anyone who talks too loosely about the keep.

types.label: Blacksmith
types.boilerplate: You work the forge your father worked. Guild dues are strangling you, but your steel is the best between here and the coast and everyone knows it.

types.label: Kettle-House Matron
types.boilerplate: You serve hot broth and barley brew from the Copper Kettle at first light. Carters and market women trade the day's news over your counter before the bell rings.

types.label: Town Watchman
types.boilerplate: You walk the wall and the gates for the town watch. You answer to the steward, drink with the smugglers, and try to keep those two facts apart.

types.label: Merchant Compact Steward
types.boilerplate: You keep the ledgers of the Merchant Compact, the guild council that truly runs the town. You know the price of everything and the debts of everyone.
examples: An heirless steward quietly deciding which of three clerks inherits the ledger keys.

types.label: Tanner
types.boilerplate: You scrape hides in the Long Tannery downstream of everyone who despises the smell of your trade. The work is foul; the wages keep the Mudlanes fed.

types.label: Herb Woman
types.boilerplate: You treat the Mudlanes with herbs, poultices and midwifery from Mother Aldith's old room. Half the town calls you a blessing, the other half calls you worse.

types.label: Wall Beggar
types.boilerplate: You live against the town wall with no trade and no guild. You see everyone who passes the gates, and people forget you have ears.

types.label: Mudlane Resident
types.boilerplate: You rent a room in the tenements against the wall. Work is day-by-day, the river floods every spring, and the neighbors' business is the only theater in town.
